entries.name: Fortress
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production military pixel arcade TERRAIN ATLAS, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows, six equal square cells with clear transparent gutters and no labels. Theme Fortress. Row-major subjects: weathered olive stone fortress paving, mossy masonry battlements, dark teal moat, iron strapped military crate, olive sandbags, damaged red battle banner. FIRST ROW cells each contain a perfectly square FULLY OPAQUE seamlessly tileable surface swatch, orthographic top-down with no perspective, no border, quiet low contrast ground, strong darker wall, visible water texture. SECOND ROW three isolated centered props: supply crate, barricade, decoration described above, genuine transparent backgrounds and clean black pixel outlines. Props in same overhead three-quarter gameplay camera. Crisp chunky pixels, copper warm highlights, deep olive shadows, authentic detailed military arcade style. Terrain must be quiet and subdued so olive hero/red soldiers are clear against it. Do not turn this into scenery, poster, isometric diorama or labeled tileset diagram. No words, no gridlines, no floor shadows, no scenery outside six cells. All six cells identical size, accurately aligned even grid with wide clear gutters.

entries.name: enemy
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet exactly 3 columns x 8 rows, 24 isolated full-body enemy soldiers on genuinely transparent background. Same chunky military pixel arcade artwork quality as reference image. Enemy identity distinct from hero: pale neutral grey military uniform, plain dark charcoal helmet without netting, face partly covered scarf, grey webbing, black boots, black rifle. Keep majority cloth grey for later red/orange/yellow tint in game. Raised rifle stock against shoulder, actively aiming forward in every direction, no low-ready across chest. Row order: down (foreshortened muzzle pointing screen bottom), right (horizontal gun), up (back view), left (horizontal gun), up-right, up-left, down-left, down-right. Columns: idle aiming, walking left step aiming, walking right step aiming. Clear consistent human proportions, same head size and body height, identical camera overhead three quarter. Uniform evenly spaced grid with large clean gutters; each sprite fully inside cell. Black outlines, olive-grey shadow, ivory metallic and warm copper highlights. No muzzleflash, labels, gridlines or floor shadows. No scenery.

entries.name: effects
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production military arcade pixel-art visual effects sprite atlas, exactly FOUR columns x FOUR rows, 16 images, genuinely transparent background. Each sprite isolated in equal square cell centered baseline, clean large gutters. Reference cover fiery orange explosions gives art style. Row1 explosion time sequence four frames: small ignition flash, large expanding orange golden fireball, billowing fire and dark smoke, small dissipating charcoal smoke. Row2 persistent molotov ground fire animation four frames same scale similar footprint, dancing orange-yellow flames over dark scorched oily puddle, periodic coherent flame flicker. Row3 separate flight sprites: olive pineapple grenade (no flame), green molotov bottle upright red lit rag, heavy olive mortar shell POINTING NOSE DOWN, red/orange enemy tracer bullet pointing right. Row4 props: wooden reinforced breakable crate with brass corner straps, small brass arrow sign pointing up with dark olive post, olive sandbag barricade overhead, charred crater ground decal. Thick pixel outlines on props, crisp chunky pixels, warm copper ivory highlights, same deep olive arcade palette. Transparent smoke edges appropriate. NO labels, text, gridlines, scenery, poster, background, watermarks, blur. No elements spill across cells.

entries.name: boss
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A fresh genuine transparent game sprite sheet, EXACTLY 2 columns x 8 rows. 16 isolated fully opaque sprites of a BURGUNDY RED MILITARY GENERAL, gold shoulder epaulettes, medals, red peaked officer cap, black mustache, tan face, black boots. Black outlined crisp chunky pixel artwork. Camera and pixel rendering as reference guerrilla sprites but DIFFERENT red officer character. NO colored background under transparent alpha: actual sprites opaque and empty space transparent. Row directions down/right/up/left/up-right/up-left/down-left/down-right. Left column actively aims PISTOL in row direction, right column actively aims SMG in row direction. Down rows point muzzle at viewer foreshortened; right rows gun barrel to screen RIGHT; left rows gun barrel to screen LEFT (including right column in row4 and row7), up rows show BACK and muzzle toward screen top. Uniform equal cells and wide transparent gaps between ALL sprites, each cell same body scale full body uncut, no glow, no ground shadows. No text, no gradient, no scenery, no poster. Clear frame grid production game sprites.
